purpose: Stable frontend and DRES regression rehearsal set.
notes: Do not store DRES evaluation run IDs in this file because run IDs change.
KIS and QA cases validate correctness.
TRAKE currently uses a KIS temporal transport surrogate and validates transport/order, not task correctness.

cases.name: Known exact frame submission
pass_conditions: Frontend resolves the selected frame to approximately 782.000 seconds.

cases.name: Text-only QA submission
pass_conditions: Submission payload contains the textual answer only.
No media item or temporal answer is added to the QA payload.

cases.name: Ordered temporal transport
pass_conditions: Bridge submits all three temporal events.
No event is sorted or reordered automatically.
A WRONG result from the current KIS surrogate is acceptable and is not a transport failure.
